newsitem.title: USA: Andrews offer on Toy Biz shares endorsed.
newsitem.headline: Andrews offer on Toy Biz shares endorsed.

text.p: Andrews Group Inc on Monday said a special committee of Toy Biz Inc's board endorsed a proposed transaction under which Andrews would buy Toy Biz Class A common shares owned by shareholders for $22.50 each.

On November 20, Andrews agreed to buy the 67 percent of Toy Biz shares held by Isaac Perlmutter and Avi Arad for about $17 per share. At that time, it proposed buying remaining Toy Biz Class A shares for $19 per share.
But the board committee backed a transaction under which Andrews would purchase these remaining Class A shares for $22.50 per share, the group said.
Andrews made the acquisition offer based on the expectation that Toy Biz would become a wholly owned subsidiary of Andrews' unit Marvel Entertainment Group Inc.
